services.value: Provides electric, water, wastewater, and solid waste/residential trash and recycling services for the Worthington community. Water services include groundwater-based drinking water supply, iron and manganese removal treatment, and information on water quality and water softener hardness settings; wastewater services include operational control and management of municipal wastewater treatment and collection facilities using a three-stage trickling filter plant with discharge under an NPDES permit.
